$ stk init
exit 0
--- stdout
  wrote $ROOT/work/supertoolkit.yaml — safe to commit, holds no secrets
  local state in $ROOT/state (0700)
  store key from STK_PASSPHRASE
  CA certificate $ROOT/state/ca.pem

  next: stk add github && stk connect github
  no browser on this machine? stk connect github --device

  about trusting the CA:
    `stk run` sets SSL_CERT_FILE and friends, which covers Go, curl,
    Python and Node on this platform. No system change needed.
--- stderr


$ stk add github
exit 0
--- stdout
  github     api.github.com · 3 read→agent, 2 write→approval
--- stderr


$ stk connect github  <<< "ghp_characterization_fixture"
exit 0
--- stdout
  github connected · substitute (token)
  1 field(s) sealed in $ROOT/state: token
  never in $ROOT/work/supertoolkit.yaml
  the stored token is what goes on the wire, so treat it as long-lived
--- stderr


$ stk reload
exit 0
--- stdout
  policy reloaded; no service changed
--- stderr


$ stk reload --json
exit 0
--- stdout
{"ok":true,"removed":[],"added":[],"changed":[]}
--- stderr


$ stk approvals
exit 0
--- stdout
  nothing is waiting on you.
--- stderr


$ stk approvals allow nosuch
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
stk: no effect "nosuch" is waiting


$ stk env
exit 0
--- stdout
export CURL_CA_BUNDLE='$ROOT/state/ca.pem'
export GH_TOKEN='stk:ref:github:v1'
export HTTPS_PROXY='http://stk:$PROXY_KEY@$PROXY_ADDR'
export HTTP_PROXY='http://stk:$PROXY_KEY@$PROXY_ADDR'
export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS='$ROOT/state/ca.pem'
export NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY='1'
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE='$ROOT/state/ca.pem'
export SSL_CERT_FILE='$ROOT/state/ca.pem'
export STK_BROKERED='1'
export http_proxy='http://stk:$PROXY_KEY@$PROXY_ADDR'
export https_proxy='http://stk:$PROXY_KEY@$PROXY_ADDR'
--- stderr

$ stk mcp serve nosuch
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
stk: unknown server "nosuch"; declared: 


$ stk serve
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
stk: $ROOT/state/stk.sock: a daemon is already listening


$ stk serve --proxy-listen $PROXY_ADDR
exit 0
--- stdout
  listening on $ROOT/state/stk.sock (0600, owner uid $UID)
  warning: no --allow-uid, so any process running as this uid (an agent too) can decide approvals;
           approvals are enforced only when agents run as their own uids (stk install)
  approvals decided only by root and this daemon's own uid, unless an agent uid
  workspace "default" · 1 service(s) · 0 profile(s)
  proxy on $PROXY_ADDR (key required; `stk env` prints the settings)
  4 meta-tools exposed to agents
  ctrl-C to stop
  SIGHUP: policy reloaded; no service changed

  stopping
--- stderr


$ stk env
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
stk: no fixed proxy is running; start `stk serve --proxy-listen <addr>`


$ stk ui --no-open --bind 127.0.0.1:0
exit 0
--- stdout
  supertoolkit is at $UI_URL
  the link carries a one-time token; the browser keeps a cookie after that
  ctrl-C to stop

  stopped
--- stderr
